facts.statement: Tenant reported on 03/09/2025: dripping kitchen tap, bathroom hot tap dripping and hard to close, water through the bathroom vent in heavy rain, damp patches on the smaller bedroom ceiling and wall.
Landlord Owen Vale replied 04/09 'Yes, please proceed' and asked the agency to check building insurance cover and review the flat's history of repeated roof leaks.
The insurance and roof-history requests were logged as not completed and were still unaddressed in the 05/09 landlord update.
Visit rebooked to Friday 12 September late morning after the contractor's 'Please cancel / Booked for tomorrow' messages; tenant agreed by phone; access took place on 12 September.

Invoice NBL-003-INV-14 dated 14/09 covers a new kitchen mixer tap and a new brass insert and chrome head on the basin hot tap; it states no amount and gives the property as 'Flat 4, 28 Larkspur Quay, Brindlewick', not the instructed Flat 4, 8-12 Juniper Mews.
No findings were recorded for the bathroom vent ingress or the bedroom damp; the invoice covers taps only.

Dispatch of a roofing/damp inspection citing event-004 as approval was rejected by the policy gate.
